sentences.text: The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — preserves a left wing along with parts of the shoulder girdle and sternum.

A fossil was discovered in 2005 near Dapingfang in Chaoyang, Western Liaoning. The species Xiangornis shenmi was named and described in 2012 by Hu Dongyu, Xu Xing, Hou Lianhai, and Corwin Sullivan. The holotype dates to the Aptian stage, approximately 120 million years ago.
Xiangornis is a member of the Enantiornithes clade of birds. This bird belongs to the subclass Enantiornithes.
Xiangornis lived during the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
